// Derived Circle custody app: raw OCTB; native consensus unchanged.
// Deploy, then finalize permissionless initialize() before accepting funds.
program OctranetCirclePayments {
  const DAY_MS: uint = 86400000
  const OPERATOR_UNSTAKE_MS: uint = 604800000
  const MIB: uint = 1048576
  const MAX_UINT: uint = 18446744073709551615
  const HEX: string = "0123456789abcdef"
  const MAX_CLASSES: uint = 32

  state {
    circle_initialized: uint
    domain: string
    max_locked_value: uint
    locked_value: uint
    min_operator_stake: uint
    operator_stake: map[address]uint
    operator_unlock: map[address]uint
    operator_generation: map[address]uint
    operator_stopped: map[address]map[uint]uint
    offer_count: uint
    offer_owner: map[uint]address
    offer_generation: map[uint]uint
    offer_manifest: map[uint]string
    offer_classes: map[uint]uint
    offer_rate: map[uint]map[uint]uint
    offer_sealed: map[uint]uint
    offer_series: map[uint]uint
    offer_parent: map[uint]uint
    offer_has_parent: map[uint]uint
    offer_start_ms: map[uint]uint
    offer_end_ms: map[uint]uint
    offer_replacement: map[uint]uint
    offer_cancelled: map[uint]uint
    generation: map[address]uint
    active: map[address]uint
    receipt_key: map[address]string
    funds: map[address]uint
    reserved: map[address]uint
    exit_deadline: map[address]uint
    plan_count: uint
    plan_payer: map[uint]address
    plan_generation: map[uint]uint
    plan_receipt_key: map[uint]string
    plan_offer: map[uint]uint
    plan_budget: map[uint]uint
    plan_opened_ms: map[uint]uint
    plan_remaining: map[uint]uint
    class_sequence: map[uint]map[uint]uint
    class_bytes: map[uint]map[uint]uint
    class_paid: map[uint]map[uint]uint
    earnings: map[address]uint
  }

  event Registered(account: address, generation: uint)
  event Funded(account: address, amount: uint)
  event OfferCreated(offer: uint, operator: address, manifest: string)
  event OfferSealed(offer: uint, classes: uint)
  event RateChangeScheduled(parent: uint, offer: uint, activation_ms: uint)
  event RateChangeCancelled(parent: uint, offer: uint)
  event PlanOpened(plan: uint, account: address, generation: uint, offer: uint, budget: uint)
  event UsageCharged(plan: uint, traffic_class: uint, sequence: uint, total_bytes: uint, increment: uint)
  event ExitRequested(account: address, deadline_ms: uint)
  event Exited(account: address, remaining: uint)
  event EarningsWithdrawn(operator: address, amount: uint)
  event EarningsAllocated(account: address, amount: uint)
  event ChannelWithdrawn(account: address, amount: uint, generation: uint)
  event OperatorBonded(operator: address, amount: uint)
  event OperatorUnstakeRequested(operator: address, deadline_ms: uint)
  event OperatorUnstaked(operator: address, amount: uint)

  // Generated immutable terms. initialize is permissionless and idempotent:
  // another caller can only install the exact terms already pinned by this code.
  const CIRCLE_DOMAIN: string = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
  const CIRCLE_CUSTODY_CAP: uint = 200000000
  const CIRCLE_MIN_STAKE: uint = 100000000

  fn initialize(): bool {
    if self.circle_initialized == 1 {
      require_initialized()
      return true
    }
    require(self.circle_initialized == 0, "invalid initialization state")
    self.domain = CIRCLE_DOMAIN
    self.max_locked_value = CIRCLE_CUSTODY_CAP
    self.min_operator_stake = CIRCLE_MIN_STAKE
    self.circle_initialized = 1
    return true
  }

  private fn require_initialized() {
    require(self.circle_initialized == 1 && self.domain == CIRCLE_DOMAIN && self.max_locked_value == CIRCLE_CUSTODY_CAP && self.min_operator_stake == CIRCLE_MIN_STAKE, "Circle payments not initialized")
  }


  private fn require_digest(text: string) {
    require(len(text) == 64, "digest must be lowercase SHA256")
    let i = 0
    while i < 64 {
      require(index_of(HEX, substr(text, i, 1)) >= 0, "digest must be lowercase SHA256")
      i = i + 1
    }
  }

  private fn require_clock() {
    require(epoch_time > 0 && epoch_time <= MAX_UINT - OPERATOR_UNSTAKE_MS, "invalid canonical clock")
  }

  private fn account_open(account: address): bool {
    return self.active[account] == 1 && self.exit_deadline[account] == 0
  }

  private fn operator_open(operator: address): bool {
    return self.operator_stake[operator] >= self.min_operator_stake && self.operator_unlock[operator] == 0
  }

  payable fn bond_operator(): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require(self.operator_unlock[caller] == 0, "operator unstaking")
    require(value > 0 && value <= self.max_locked_value - self.locked_value, "custody cap exceeded")
    if self.operator_stake[caller] == 0 {
      require(self.operator_generation[caller] < MAX_UINT, "operator generation exhausted")
      self.operator_generation[caller] = self.operator_generation[caller] + 1
    }
    self.operator_stake[caller] = self.operator_stake[caller] + value
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value + value
    emit OperatorBonded(caller, value)
    return true
  }

  // Stop new paid admission immediately; neither a retry nor another person's
  // transaction can shorten or extend this operator's seven-day deadline.
  fn request_operator_unstake(): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(self.operator_stake[caller] > 0, "no operator stake")
    if self.operator_unlock[caller] == 0 {
      self.operator_unlock[caller] = epoch_time + OPERATOR_UNSTAKE_MS
      self.operator_stopped[caller][self.operator_generation[caller]] = epoch_time
      emit OperatorUnstakeRequested(caller, self.operator_unlock[caller])
    }
    return self.operator_unlock[caller]
  }

  nonreentrant fn withdraw_operator_stake(): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(self.operator_stake[caller] > 0 && self.operator_unlock[caller] > 0, "unstake not requested")
    require(epoch_time >= self.operator_unlock[caller], "operator unstake window open")
    let amount = self.operator_stake[caller]
    self.operator_stake[caller] = 0
    self.operator_unlock[caller] = 0
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value - amount
    require(transfer(caller, amount), "unstake transfer failed")
    emit OperatorUnstaked(caller, amount)
    return amount
  }

  // Receipt keys are scoped to a funding generation. Closing or partially
  // withdrawing the channel invalidates old plans before value leaves custody.
  fn register(receipt_key: string, signature: string): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require(self.active[caller] == 0, "account already active")
    require(self.funds[caller] == 0 && self.reserved[caller] == 0, "account not empty")
    require(self.generation[caller] < MAX_UINT, "generation exhausted")
    require(len(receipt_key) == 44 && len(signature) == 88, "invalid receipt key or signature")
    let next = self.generation[caller] + 1
    let message = concat("Octranet register v1|", self.domain)
    message = concat(message, concat("|", self_addr))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", caller))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(next)))
    require(ed25519_ok(receipt_key, message, signature), "receipt key possession failed")
    self.generation[caller] = next
    self.receipt_key[caller] = receipt_key
    self.active[caller] = 1
    self.exit_deadline[caller] = 0
    emit Registered(caller, next)
    return next
  }

  payable fn fund(account: address): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require(account_open(account), "account not accepting funds")
    require(value > 0 && value <= self.max_locked_value - self.locked_value, "custody cap exceeded")
    self.funds[account] = self.funds[account] + value
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value + value
    emit Funded(account, value)
    return true
  }

  // The Circle manifest contains enforceable selectors and the displayed
  // rates. Clients compare every rate below to that hash-pinned manifest.
  fn create_offer(manifest_hash: string): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require(operator_open(caller), "operator unavailable")
    require_digest(manifest_hash)
    require(self.offer_count < MAX_UINT, "offers exhausted")
    let id = self.offer_count
    self.offer_count = id + 1
    self.offer_owner[id] = caller
    self.offer_generation[id] = self.operator_generation[caller]
    self.offer_manifest[id] = manifest_hash
    self.offer_series[id] = id
    emit OfferCreated(id, caller, manifest_hash)
    return id
  }

  private fn quote_open(offer: uint): bool {
    let end = self.offer_end_ms[offer]
    return self.offer_sealed[offer] == 1 && self.offer_cancelled[offer] == 0 && epoch_time >= self.offer_start_ms[offer] && (end == 0 || epoch_time < end)
  }

  // A replacement is a fresh immutable quote in the same product lineage.
  // Separate base offers are separate products, never a reprice of old consent.
  fn create_rate_change(parent: uint, manifest_hash: string): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(parent < self.offer_count && self.offer_owner[parent] == caller, "not offer operator")
    require(operator_open(caller), "operator unavailable")
    require(self.offer_generation[parent] == self.operator_generation[caller], "operator generation closed")
    require(quote_open(parent), "parent quote inactive")
    require_digest(manifest_hash)
    require(self.offer_count < MAX_UINT, "offers exhausted")
    let id = self.offer_count
    self.offer_count = id + 1
    self.offer_owner[id] = caller
    self.offer_generation[id] = self.operator_generation[caller]
    self.offer_manifest[id] = manifest_hash
    self.offer_series[id] = self.offer_series[parent]
    self.offer_parent[id] = parent
    self.offer_has_parent[id] = 1
    emit OfferCreated(id, caller, manifest_hash)
    return id
  }

  fn append_class(offer: uint, rate_ou_per_mib: uint): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require(offer < self.offer_count && self.offer_owner[offer] == caller, "not offer operator")
    require(self.offer_sealed[offer] == 0, "offer immutable")
    require(rate_ou_per_mib <= MAX_UINT, "rate exceeds uint64")
    let id = self.offer_classes[offer]
    require(id < MAX_CLASSES, "too many classes")
    self.offer_rate[offer][id] = rate_ou_per_mib
    self.offer_classes[offer] = id + 1
    return id
  }

  fn seal_offer(offer: uint): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(offer < self.offer_count && self.offer_owner[offer] == caller, "not offer operator")
    require(self.offer_sealed[offer] == 0 && self.offer_classes[offer] > 0, "invalid offer state")
    require(operator_open(caller), "operator unavailable")
    require(self.offer_generation[offer] == self.operator_generation[caller], "operator generation closed")
    if self.offer_has_parent[offer] == 1 {
      let parent = self.offer_parent[offer]
      require(quote_open(parent), "parent quote inactive")
      let previous = self.offer_replacement[parent]
      if previous > 0 {
        require(epoch_time < self.offer_start_ms[previous], "rate change already active")
        self.offer_cancelled[previous] = 1
        emit RateChangeCancelled(parent, previous)
      }
      let activation = epoch_time + DAY_MS
      self.offer_start_ms[offer] = activation
      self.offer_end_ms[parent] = activation
      self.offer_replacement[parent] = offer
      emit RateChangeScheduled(parent, offer, activation)
    } else {
      self.offer_start_ms[offer] = epoch_time
    }
    self.offer_sealed[offer] = 1
    emit OfferSealed(offer, self.offer_classes[offer])
    return true
  }

  fn cancel_rate_change(offer: uint): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(offer < self.offer_count && self.offer_owner[offer] == caller, "not offer operator")
    require(self.offer_sealed[offer] == 1 && self.offer_has_parent[offer] == 1 && self.offer_cancelled[offer] == 0, "rate change not pending")
    require(epoch_time < self.offer_start_ms[offer], "rate change already active")
    let parent = self.offer_parent[offer]
    require(self.offer_replacement[parent] == offer, "rate change not pending")
    self.offer_cancelled[offer] = 1
    self.offer_replacement[parent] = 0
    self.offer_end_ms[parent] = 0
    emit RateChangeCancelled(parent, offer)
    return true
  }

  fn open_plan(offer: uint, budget: uint): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(account_open(caller), "account exiting or inactive")
    require(offer < self.offer_count && self.offer_sealed[offer] == 1, "offer not sealed")
    require(quote_open(offer), "offer quote inactive")
    require(operator_open(self.offer_owner[offer]), "operator unavailable")
    require(self.offer_generation[offer] == self.operator_generation[self.offer_owner[offer]], "operator generation closed")
    require(budget > 0, "budget unavailable")
    let available = self.funds[caller] - self.reserved[caller]
    if budget > available {
      let needed = budget - available
      require(needed <= self.earnings[caller], "budget unavailable")
      self.earnings[caller] = self.earnings[caller] - needed
      self.funds[caller] = self.funds[caller] + needed
      emit EarningsAllocated(caller, needed)
    }
    require(self.plan_count < MAX_UINT, "plans exhausted")
    let id = self.plan_count
    self.plan_count = id + 1
    self.plan_payer[id] = caller
    self.plan_generation[id] = self.generation[caller]
    self.plan_receipt_key[id] = self.receipt_key[caller]
    self.plan_offer[id] = offer
    self.plan_budget[id] = budget
    self.plan_opened_ms[id] = epoch_time
    self.plan_remaining[id] = budget
    self.reserved[caller] = self.reserved[caller] + budget
    emit PlanOpened(id, caller, self.generation[caller], offer, budget)
    return id
  }

  private fn usage_message(plan: uint, traffic_class: uint, sequence: uint, total_bytes: uint): string {
    let message = concat("Octranet prepaid v1|", self.domain)
    message = concat(message, concat("|", self_addr))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", self.plan_payer[plan]))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(self.plan_generation[plan])))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(plan)))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(self.plan_offer[plan])))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", self.offer_manifest[self.plan_offer[plan]]))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(traffic_class)))
    message = concat(message, concat("|", to_string(sequence)))
    return concat(message, concat("|", to_string(total_bytes)))
  }

  private fn operator_claim_open(offer: uint): bool {
    let operator = self.offer_owner[offer]
    return operator_open(operator) && self.offer_generation[offer] == self.operator_generation[operator]
  }

  // Anyone can deliver the payer's exact prepaid purchase authorization.
  // The immutable offer selects the beneficiary; a relayer can neither redirect
  // nor increase it. Purchased capacity is separate from off-chain consumption.
  nonreentrant fn claim(plan: uint, traffic_class: uint, sequence: uint, total_bytes: uint, signature: string): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(plan < self.plan_count, "plan not found")
    let payer = self.plan_payer[plan]
    require(self.active[payer] == 1 && self.plan_generation[plan] == self.generation[payer], "plan generation closed")
    let deadline = self.exit_deadline[payer]
    // A stopped connection must not buy unusable future bytes from a held
    // signature. Prepaid forwarding has no delivered-but-unsettled traffic debt.
    require(deadline == 0, "claim window closed")
    let offer = self.plan_offer[plan]
    require(operator_claim_open(offer), "operator settlement window closed")
    require(quote_open(offer), "offer quote inactive")
    require(traffic_class < self.offer_classes[offer], "class not found")
    require(sequence > 0 && sequence <= MAX_UINT, "invalid receipt sequence")
    // A payer must not invalidate a larger authorization by racing a tiny
    // receipt with a higher sequence. Cumulative usage, rather than sequence,
    // determines redemption and duplicate protection.
    require(total_bytes > self.class_bytes[plan][traffic_class] && total_bytes <= MAX_UINT, "usage already redeemed or exceeds uint64")
    require(len(signature) == 88, "invalid signature size")
    require(ed25519_ok(self.receipt_key[payer], usage_message(plan, traffic_class, sequence, total_bytes), signature), "invalid usage authorization")
    let rate = self.offer_rate[offer][traffic_class]
    let cumulative = (total_bytes * rate + MIB - 1) / MIB
    require(cumulative >= self.class_paid[plan][traffic_class] && cumulative <= MAX_UINT, "charge exceeds uint64")
    let increment = cumulative - self.class_paid[plan][traffic_class]
    require(increment <= self.plan_remaining[plan], "plan budget exhausted")
    require(increment <= self.reserved[payer] && increment <= self.funds[payer], "account budget exhausted")
    if sequence > self.class_sequence[plan][traffic_class] {
      self.class_sequence[plan][traffic_class] = sequence
    }
    self.class_bytes[plan][traffic_class] = total_bytes
    self.class_paid[plan][traffic_class] = cumulative
    self.plan_remaining[plan] = self.plan_remaining[plan] - increment
    self.reserved[payer] = self.reserved[payer] - increment
    self.funds[payer] = self.funds[payer] - increment
    let operator = self.offer_owner[offer]
    self.earnings[operator] = self.earnings[operator] + increment
    emit UsageCharged(plan, traffic_class, sequence, total_bytes, increment)
    return increment
  }

  // Stopped providers cannot accept another prepaid purchase, so their unused
  // allocations can be released immediately. Purchased bytes remain final.
  fn release_stopped_plan(plan: uint): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(plan < self.plan_count && self.plan_payer[plan] == caller, "not plan payer")
    require(self.active[caller] == 1 && self.plan_generation[plan] == self.generation[caller], "plan generation closed")
    let offer = self.plan_offer[plan]
    let stopped = self.operator_stopped[self.offer_owner[offer]][self.offer_generation[offer]]
    require(stopped > 0, "operator not stopped")
    let amount = self.plan_remaining[plan]
    self.plan_remaining[plan] = 0
    self.reserved[caller] = self.reserved[caller] - amount
    return amount
  }

  fn request_exit(): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(self.active[caller] == 1, "account inactive")
    if self.exit_deadline[caller] == 0 {
      self.exit_deadline[caller] = epoch_time
      emit ExitRequested(caller, self.exit_deadline[caller])
    }
    return self.exit_deadline[caller]

  nonreentrant fn withdraw_remaining(): uint {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    let amount = self.funds[caller] + self.earnings[caller]
    require(self.active[caller] == 1 || amount > 0, "channel inactive or empty")
    self.funds[caller] = 0
    self.earnings[caller] = 0
    self.reserved[caller] = 0
    self.active[caller] = 0
    self.exit_deadline[caller] = epoch_time
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value - amount
    if amount > 0 {
      require(transfer(caller, amount), "withdrawal failed")
    }
    emit Exited(caller, amount)
    return amount
  }

  // Every old plan is invalidated before even a partial withdrawal. This
  // releases its unspent allocations without making old purchase signatures
  // redeemable against the remaining channel balance.
  nonreentrant fn withdraw_channel(amount: uint): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require_clock()
    require(self.active[caller] == 1, "account inactive")
    require(amount > 0 && amount <= self.funds[caller] + self.earnings[caller], "channel balance unavailable")
    require(self.generation[caller] < MAX_UINT, "generation exhausted")
    self.generation[caller] = self.generation[caller] + 1
    self.reserved[caller] = 0
    if amount <= self.funds[caller] {
      self.funds[caller] = self.funds[caller] - amount
    } else {
      let rest = amount - self.funds[caller]
      self.funds[caller] = 0
      self.earnings[caller] = self.earnings[caller] - rest
    }
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value - amount
    require(transfer(caller, amount), "channel withdrawal failed")
    emit ChannelWithdrawn(caller, amount, self.generation[caller])
    return true
  }

  nonreentrant fn withdraw_earnings(amount: uint): bool {
    require_initialized()

    require(amount > 0 && amount <= self.earnings[caller], "earnings unavailable")
    self.earnings[caller] = self.earnings[caller] - amount
    self.locked_value = self.locked_value - amount
    require(transfer(caller, amount), "earnings transfer failed")
    emit EarningsWithdrawn(caller, amount)
    return true
  }
